meta.name: tfx-psmux-rules
meta.description: legacy alias. Phase 4b부터 psmux 규칙의 source of truth는 skill이 아니라 .claude/rules/tfx-psmux.md 와 AGENTS.md 의 always-on policy 이다.

copy.tagline: 指向项目规则的权威文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目规则已经迁移,需要找到新的权威来源
copy.tagline_en: Point to the authoritative project rule file
copy.fit_line_en: For you if rules moved to a new file and you need the current source

howto.what: 这是一个已废弃的旧名称。提及它时，Claude 会先运行一条 bash 命令记录废弃日志，然后引导你查看 .claude/rules/tfx-psmux.md 和 AGENTS.md 中的规则，不再执行任何旧功能。
howto.when: 当你说出“tfx-psmux-rules”或“psmux-rules”等触发词，要求按此规则处理时触发。

say.text: 请按 tfx-psmux-rules 规则处理
say.note: Claude 会记录日志并指向新版规则文档。
Claude 会告知两个权威文件的位置。

say.text: 我需要遵守 psmux 规则吗？
say.note: Claude 会说明该旧名称已废弃，并给出新来源。

howto.what_en: This is a deprecated alias. When invoked, Claude runs a bash command to log the deprecation, then redirects you to .claude/rules/tfx-psmux.md and the AGENTS.md rules section. No old functionality is executed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "tfx-psmux-rules" or "psmux-rules" and ask to apply rules under that name.

say_en.note: Claude logs the alias and points to the new docs.
Claude names the two authoritative files.

say_en.text: Do I need to follow psmux rules?
say_en.note: Claude explains the alias is deprecated and cites new sources.
